steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the create screen is valid.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template, corresponding to choosing Buy Template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Use the participant picker to select and save the named vendor.
Verify the selected vendor appears in the RFQ Participants list.
